shared_elements: stone surface carved in low relief
limbs and hands rendered schematically against the flat ground
justification: Both are tan stone panels bearing profile figures in shallow relief with a horizontal dividing band, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A stacks isolated animal forms in tiers with bold, rounded, sculptural modelling, while B presents a unified human scene (seated figure with cup facing an attendant) rendered in fine incised linear detail with dense textile patterning, so subject matter, composition and carving technique all diverge.
